newsitem.title: USA: Motorola releases 33.6 kbps modem cards.
newsitem.headline: Motorola releases 33.6 kbps modem cards.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday its 28.8 modem/fax PC card, called Montana, is now available with 33.6 kilobits per second transmission capabilities.
The company said its Mariner modem/fax/LAN adapter card will be available next month in a 33.6 Kbps version.
Motorola said the cards consistently connect up to 15 percent faster than 28.8 modems. Both can be used with cellular phones, the company said.
THe 33.6 Montana has a list price of $309, and the Mariner will carry a list price of $399.
